name: code-agent-clis-app-ui
description: Component-mode frontend for aw-app-code-agent-clis — the Agents nav menu (launch/resume claude/codex/copilot/cursor sessions), ported from aw-workspace-ui's AgentsNav.jsx and registered into the core.nav slot. src/client.js is the framework-free API client; src/plugin.jsx is the integrated-mode entry (register(host)), built as a Vite lib-mode bundle consumed by aw-app.json's contributes.frontend.bundle.
